title: IBLTs Measure Before They Decode: Self-Sizing Set Reconciliation for Database Consistency Verification (artifact)
description:
Public artifact for the paper IBLTs Measure Before They Decode: Self-Sizing Set Reconciliation for Database Consistency Verification: simulation and replay code, the reviewed aggregate CSVs behind the paper's figures and tables, and reproduction instructions.

The large raw simulation inputs are not part of this Zenodo archive; they are attached to the v0.1 GitHub release, with byte counts and SHA-256 recorded in data/manifest.tsv. Production comparison logs and other operational data are not distributed.
